description: This file contains a class 'AesGcm' providing a polyfill implementation for AES-GCM encryption and decryption, including key management, process flow, and cryptographic operations using OpenSSL. It supports specific configurations such as nonce length and key sizes, and includes methods for encrypting and decrypting data with authentication tags.

classes.name: AesGcm
classes.description: A class to provide AES-GCM encryption/decryption functionality as a polyfill, supporting key validation, streaming authentication tags, and customizable parameters for cryptographic operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AesGcm object with an encryption key, key size, and block size after validating input parameters.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts plaintext data using AES-GCM with the provided nonce, key, and additional authenticated data; outputs ciphertext and authentication tag.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts ciphertext data using AES-GCM, verifying the authentication tag to ensure data integrity.

methods.name: gmacInit
methods.description: Initializes a GMAC object with the nonce and key for generating or verifying authentication tags.

methods.name: strlen
methods.description: Determines the length of a string in a way compatible across different PHP configurations.

methods.name: substr
methods.description: Returns a substring from a string, handling multibyte functions safely.
